findings.title: Trailing seeding can miss truncated sessions older than the priority window
findings.description: The truncated-day index is built only from `trailing_floor`, but that floor is the short trailing-priority window. A truncated session older than this window is therefore not passed as `uncovered_days`; if the coarse coverage index marks it covered, the normal seed still will not recreate its gap. This leaves older truncated sessions dependent on a separate repair run, despite the new cycle seeding logic. Consider scanning the full seedable history or explicitly bounding and documenting which truncations this cycle can recover.

findings.title: Sudoers grants root access to an operator-writable installer
findings.description: `MT_INSTALL` allows `manta` to run the installer from `/home/manta/source/repos/manta/trading-data`. Since that checkout is operator-writable, the operator can modify the script and execute arbitrary commands as root through the NOPASSWD rule. Install or invoke a root-owned, non-writable copy of the installer instead; also note that the alias is defined but not included in the root command grant on line 13.
